newsitem.title: USA: Pittston sees Q2 charge of $0.40 a share.
newsitem.headline: Pittston sees Q2 charge of $0.40 a share.

text.p: Pittston Burlington Group Inc said Wednesday it expects to take a $13 million special charge in the second quarter, or $.40 a share, related to the company's redesigning its Burlington Air Express.
Burlington said it expected to post a $0.30 a share operating profit in the second quarter, excluding the charge.
"We expect full year results to be in line with current estimates of $1.90 to $2.00 per share, exclusive of any special expenses," said Chief Executive Joseph Farrell in a statement.

An April 30 First Call estimate of five brokers put the company's second-quarter earnings at $0.52 a share and the full year's at $1.97 a share. The company said it planned to release its actual second-quarter results on July 24.

Burlington said the $13 million charge relates to the developing information technology and redesigning its customer service program, which it will implement over the next two years. The charge represents consulting fees and other future project expenses, it added.
The company projected $5 million to $10 million in annualized cost savings from the initiatives.
Pittston Burlington said declining domestic car shipments also hurt its second-quarter results.

On the plus side, the company said its international operating results improved in the second quarter. It added its recently completed acquisition of logistics provider Cleton & Co of the Netherlands will enhance international revenue growth.
The freight company's stock traded at 29-1/8 Wednesday morning, down 3/8 but close to its 52-week high of $30-3/4.
